limited: This calibration does not establish that dendrites, neural tissue, fluids, or other physical substrates use this mechanism.
supported: The TheoryLab runtime can represent a persistent stateful mechanism whose addressed writes compose in an order-dependent way.
The destructive frozen-write control removes the effect in this calibration world.

gates.meaning: Reversing the same two writes changes the later probe response.
When persistent rewrite is disabled, the matched order manipulation has no effect.

limitations: The rank-1 update law is deliberately constructed to provide a known-answer noncommutative case.
The experiment is infrastructure calibration, not evidence for a natural system.
